narrative: All three coins posted slim gains — bitcoin +0.83%, ethereum +0.52%, solana +0.52% — even as the Coldcard exploit entered a fifth day, with losses nearing $114 million across a possible fourth sweep per CoinDesk, prices and security news moving in opposite directions for the second straight session. Bernstein warned Clarity Act failure this session could trigger another leg lower per CoinDesk, with the Senate recess now imminent and the bill still unresolved.
